demo.program:
# George R.R. Martin — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is George R.R. Martin known for?", "A Song of Ice and Fire"),
    ("What field did George R.R. Martin work in?", "fantasy"),
    ("What is lived?", "1948-"),
    ("What is field?", "fantasy"),
    ("What is known for?", "A Song of Ice and Fire"),
    ("What is note?", "Grimdark fantasy summit"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
